title: DAY 2 — LESSON 4: BEING COURTEOUS EVEN WHEN YOU DISAGREE

questions.prompt: A colleague disagrees with your suggestion during a staff meeting.
options: Tell her she doesn't know what she's talking about.
Ask her to explain her perspective and discuss the options.
Refuse to speak to her afterward.

questions.prompt: Your supervisor gives an instruction you believe is unclear.
options: Complain to colleagues that the supervisor is incompetent.

questions.prompt: A coworker speaks sharply to you because she is frustrated.
options: Spread the incident around the workplace.
Remain calm, set a respectful boundary and escalate if necessary.

questions.prompt: You realise your suggestion was not the best option.
options: Continue arguing to protect your pride.
Acknowledge the better option and cooperate.
Blame someone else for the discussion.
Suggest a short pause and return to the issue calmly.
Raise your voice to make yourself heard.
